scenarios.name: exile-to-protect-a-legendary-creature
scenarios.why: The {3}, {T}, Exile Plaza of Heroes ability targets a legendary creature I control; Giada gains hexproof and indestructible until end of turn, and the Plaza exiles itself as a cost.

scenarios.name: cannot-target-a-nonlegendary-creature
scenarios.why: The ability's target must be a legendary creature; Grizzly Bears is not, so with only a nonlegendary creature the activation has no legal target and is not offered.
